content: {"phoneNote":"The signpost motif eats the lower half of the first screen while the hero photo is darkened so heavily it reads as a grey wash, and the contact block (address, Navodila za pot, email) repeats three times down the page.","desktopNote":"The hero's whole-page darkening and the empty right half of the rooms and pricing sections leave a strong photo wasted and large dead columns, and the signpost widgets duplicate the trail list below.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Lift the dark overlay to a gradient behind the text only so the valley photo actually shows, and drop or shrink the hero signposts since the same trails are listed in 'Poti in cilji v bližini'.","Merge the three contact repetitions (dark Rezervacije block, 'Obiščite nas', footer) into one contact section with address, phone, email and hours once.","Fill the empty right columns on desktop (rooms, prices) with room photos or move to a two-column layout, and give the phone hero a single primary 'Rezervirajte' action matching desktop."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: address, 'Navodila za pot' link and email are repeated in the Rezervacije section, the 'Obiščite nas' section and the footer.","Phone and desktop: the Raduha/Logarska dolina/Smučišče signposts in the hero duplicate the same three items in the 'Poti in cilji v bližini' section."]}
